basic_info.description: Discover this stunningly renovated and expanded home, offering a perfect blend of modern sophistication and thoughtful design. Taken down to the studs and meticulously rebuilt, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom residence is ready to impress! Step into the open-concept main floor where the fully remodeled kitchen steals the show. It features sleek flat-panel cabinets, elegant quartz countertops, and stainless steel appliances, ideal for cooking and entertaining. Flow seamlessly into the dining area and living room, where a chic electric fireplace adds warmth and a modern touch. The primary suite offers a serene retreat with its private bath, while a second bedroom and updated hallway bath complete the upper level. The lower level offers versatility and comfort with a spacious family room, two additional bedrooms, and two beautifully updated bathrooms. Tile flooring and contemporary tile showers elevate the baths' aesthetic appeal. Perfect for families, multigenerational living, or entertaining guests, this home combines modern luxury with a practical layout. Don't miss this opportunity to own a beautifully reimagined property!
